2026_02_SEA_ARI.headline: Drew Lock’s road start puts Seattle’s offensive discipline at the center in Arizona
2026_02_SEA_ARI.paragraph1: Seattle turns to Drew Lock with Sam Darnold ruled out, asking the backup to manage a road divisional game against an Arizona team coming off an opening win. Lock was efficient in relief last week, while Seattle’s defense again showed it can keep games compressed. The Cardinals must handle Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Seattle’s physical run game; the Seahawks need Lock to avoid negative plays and prevent Arizona’s coverage disguises from creating short fields.
2026_02_SEA_ARI.model_rationale: Lock’s ball security and timing against Arizona’s coverage structure, paired with the Cardinals’ ability to contain Seattle’s primary receiving threat, should shape possession quality and field position.
